name: James Hype: cue drumming and loops
lesson:
## Drums on both decks, then a loop build

Bars 1 to 4: kick on A1 every beat, snare on A2 on 2 and 4, hat on A3 on every off-beat. Bars 5 to 8: the same pattern with the kick and snare from deck B's cues while A's hat continues. Bars 13 to 16: a halving loop on B, IN/4BEAT on each downbeat, exit on the one of bar 17.

DJ Mag's "How I DJ" with Hype describes four-deck hot-cue drumming and loop builds; this is the two-deck reduction. The pads are an instrument, so the pattern is scored like a drummer: every hit on the grid, the off-beat hat especially. Switching decks mid-pattern without dropping a hit is the Hype part.

tracks.cue: A1 kick, A2 clap, A3 hat from the intro: the drum pattern for bars 1 to 4.
B's kick and snare cues take over for bars 5 to 8; the halving loop on B from bar 13, exit on 17.
